user.title: Add your Volcano Hybrid
user.description: Pick the vaporizer you want to add. Only devices Home Assistant can currently see over Bluetooth are listed.

data_description.address: The Volcano Hybrid to control. If yours is missing, switch it on and wait a few seconds for it to advertise.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add your Volcano Hybrid
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

options.title: Startup behaviour
options.description: Optional settings applied to {name} ({address}) whenever Home Assistant starts up or reloads this integration. You can change these later without re-adding the device.

data_description.initial_temperature: Target temperature in °C written on startup, between {min_temp} and {max_temp}. Leave empty to keep whatever the device already has.
data_description.fan_on_connect: Run the fan when Home Assistant starts. This applies once per startup or reload, not on every Bluetooth reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Check the connection
reconfigure.description: This will try to connect to {name} at {address} right now. The Bluetooth address of a vaporizer never changes, so there is nothing to re-point — use this to confirm Home Assistant can still reach it.

manual.title: Enter the Bluetooth address
manual.description: Use this when the vaporizer has not been discovered. Its address is printed in the Storz & Bickel app and in Home Assistant's Bluetooth advertisement monitor. A vaporizer that is not in range yet is still added, and connects the first time it is switched on near an adapter or proxy.

data_description.address: Six pairs of hex digits separated by colons, for example DD:BA:AA:DE:1F:F9.
data_description.model: Which Storz & Bickel device this is. The Crafty, Venty and Veazy are experimental: they are decoded from the vendor's app and have not been tested on hardware.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the vaporizer is switched on and is not already connected to the Storz & Bickel app.
error.not_in_range: The device is not currently visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.invalid_address: That is not a Bluetooth address. Use six pairs of hex digits separated by colons.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported Storz & Bickel device.

init.title: Startup behaviour
init.description: These are applied whenever Home Assistant starts up or reloads this integration.

data_description.initial_temperature: Target temperature in °C written on startup, between {min_temp} and {max_temp}. Leave empty to keep whatever the device already has.
data_description.fan_on_connect: Run the fan when Home Assistant starts. This applies once per startup or reload, not on every Bluetooth reconnect.
data_description.auto_connect_delay: Seconds to wait after hearing the vaporizer before connecting, so the strongest Bluetooth adapter or proxy is chosen rather than the first. Keep this low.
data_description.delayed_reconnect_delay: Seconds the Reconnect after delay button stays disconnected. The vaporizer advertises about every ten seconds, so the default guarantees a fresh advertisement.

confirm.title: {name} is refusing connections
confirm.description:
The vaporizer is advertising, so it is in range, but it will not accept a connection.

A Volcano Hybrid allows only one Bluetooth connection at a time. The usual cause is the Storz & Bickel app on a phone or tablet holding the link.

Close that app — or turn off Bluetooth on the device running it — and then select Submit to retry.

confirm.title: {name} is connected but not responding
confirm.description:
The vaporizer accepted the connection and then answered nothing. Home Assistant has already dropped the link and rebuilt it from scratch several times without getting a reply.

This is not another app holding the connection — the vaporizer let Home Assistant in, so closing the Storz & Bickel app will not help. It usually means the vaporizer's Bluetooth has locked up.

Switch the vaporizer off at the plug, wait a few seconds, switch it back on, and then select Submit to retry.

legacy_integration_installed.title: Remove the old Volcano Hybrid folder
legacy_integration_installed.description:
This integration was renamed from `{legacy_domain}` to Storz & Bickel BLE, and the old copy is still installed at `custom_components/{legacy_domain}`. Both would compete for the vaporizer's single Bluetooth connection, so your existing device has not been moved across yet.

Delete the `custom_components/{legacy_domain}` folder and restart Home Assistant. The device and every entity then move across with their entity IDs unchanged.
